node.name: Setup Guide
node.rich_text:
SETUP GUIDE
Requirements • Visual Studio • .NET Windows Forms • MySQL Server • MySQL Workbench • Git • GitHub • CherryTree
1. Clone the GitHub Repository Clone the group's GitHub repository to the computer.
2. Open the Visual Studio Project Open the Student Information System solution (.sln) in Visual Studio.
3. Set Up the Database Open MySQL Workbench and make sure MySQL Server is running.
Use the provided SQL script:
student_information_system.sql
The script creates the database and students table.
4. Check the Database Connection Open the project in Visual Studio and check the database connection settings in Database.cs.
The application should connect to:
Database: student_information_system Table: students
5. Run the Application Start the application from Visual Studio.
The application should display the existing student records in the DataGridView.
6. Test the Features Test the following: • Add a student • View student records • Search by Student ID or Name • Update a student • Delete a student • Clear the input fields
7. GitHub Commit changes regularly and push them to the group's GitHub repository.
